scope: Existing-source/canonical-outcome inventory only; no extraction, new appraisal or scientific import.

profiles.gap: Acute controlled reports exist, but no D02 outcome assessment is recorded; REVIVE is quarantined. The metformin COVID-OUT row is the wrong drug.
Combination, pharmacodynamic, mouse and human healthspan records exist. None has a D06 canonical assessed outcome; the endpoints cannot be combined or called longevity benefit.
Acute recovery reports and nonclinical oncology/mechanistic records exist. No D08 assessed outcome; metformin COVID-OUT effects cannot be borrowed.
Human liver-injury cases and preclinical tumor records exist. Neither harms cases nor cell/mouse findings establish anticancer benefit; no assessed D10 outcome.
Uncontrolled guanfacine plus NAC series exists. No exact combination-specific assessed outcome; do not isolate guanfacine benefit or invent a comparator.
Preclinical and exploratory human tumor/phase-I records exist. No exact D12 assessed outcome, and mechanism is not clinical benefit.
Five-person uncontrolled vitiligo pilot exists. No exact D14 assessed outcome; no randomized effect can be inferred.
Label and laboratory NMDA/temozolomide record only in the linked set; exact memantine experimental scope is incomplete and no patient efficacy row is recorded.
Class/combination models, observational tumor analysis and healthy-volunteer physiology exist. They are not interchangeable clinical sildenafil effects; no D26 assessed row.
Patient-cell TRPM3 investigation is mechanistic; contextual symptom-care sources are not treatment effects. No C06 assessed outcome.
Phenotype/neurological studies are not comparative drug results. Existing naltrexone CSBD outcome belongs to C07, not PGAD C08.
Preclinical models, secondary context and supportive thromboprophylaxis report exist. No exact assessed C21 outcome; clot prevention is not tumor control.
All five linked sources are context, labels or methods. No comparative repurposed-treatment result is recorded here; no outcome data yet for this table.
Labels/guidelines and isolate/biofilm experiments exist; fluconazole negative comparator must not inherit itraconazole findings. No assessed D34 outcome.
Positive and null Raynaud crossover reports and distinct brain-physiology studies exist. No exact assessed D31 outcome; preserve conflicting findings and scope.
Mouse survival/oral-health and human healthspan/physical-function reports exist. Sarcopenia rows are not general aging/lifespan rows, and no GOAL-AGING assessed row exists.

sourceRecord.title: Expression of fluconazole resistance-associated genes in biofilm from 23 clinical isolates of Candida albicans
sourceRecord.preview: Clinical Candida isolates became less susceptible to fluconazole as laboratory biofilms matured. The experiment does not support describing fluconazole as a general biofilm-destroying drug.
sourceRecord.decisiveLimit: Plate biofilms and a nonstandardized biofilm inoculum limit clinical interpretation; prevention is distinct from eradication.
